name: Apple-Cranberry White Bean Salad Toasts with Walnut Romaine Salad
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Place yogurt, mayo, onion powder, and salt in a medium bowl. Stir to combine the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples. Add to the bowl along with the cranberries.
Drain and rinse beans. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the bean salad, and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Place in another medium bowl.
Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the lettuce along with additional cranberries, dressing, and salt. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.
Arrange bread on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide toast between plates and top with bean salad. Serve with romaine salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
